label: sec:knot-fundamental-groups
html: The Wirtinger presentation of the knot-complement fundamental group \pi_1(S^3 \setminus K) translates braid conjugacy relations into geometric representation varieties \mathrm{Hom}(\pi_1(S^3 \setminus K), \mathrm{SU}(2)). By the theorem of Kronheimer and Mrowka [kronheimer2004], every nontrivial knot admits an irreducible \mathrm{SU}(2) representation, while the reducible locus factors through the abelianization H_1(S^3 \setminus K) \cong \mathbb{Z} and isolates the Alexander polynomial at the boundary between abelian and non-abelian Hecke channels.
